question: How does the online gameplay difference between ordinary root c=25 and root-only c=35 vary with exact per-root simulation budget from 100 to 10000?
classification: exploratory online interaction curve; not a promotion gate

population.freshness: No exact 934500-934515 experiment block was found in maintained evidence before preregistration.

analysis_rules: Run paired_analysis.py without --allow-partial for every budget.
Report every predeclared cell; do not stop or modify the grid after results begin.
Treat all cells as noisy exploratory estimates and do not promote c=35 from this 16-seed block.
Do not pool repeated budget cells as independent samples because the same sixteen seeds are reused.
Use the curve only to choose the simulation budget of a separately preregistered promotion test if a coherent region appears.
integrity_gate: Every arm contains exactly the same sixteen unique seeds 934500-934515.
Every telemetry simulation total is a positive multiple of that cell's exact budget.
No conversion, semantic-resolution, transaction, knowledge, or seed-boundary failure occurs.
Telemetry parses structurally and frozen executable/model hashes match.
non_goals: No change to internal deterministic c, chance c, widening, reuse, adaptive search, evaluator, or policy.
No default promotion from sixteen seeds.
